value_type: measured_level_change = STOCK, mixes buying+valuation, directly from DFA, no assumption. ESTIMATE_apportioned_flow = NOT a Fed-published number -- our own allocation of the aggregate Z.1 household FLOW across wealth groups assuming each group's share of new buying equals its average share of the existing stock. This assumption is UNTESTED: if wealthier groups buy disproportionately more (or less) than their existing share, or if portfolio composition/returns differ by group, the true split differs from this allocation.
method_note: Aggregate Z.1 household+nonprofit corporate-equities FLOW 2024:Q1-2026:Q1 (9q, matched to DFA's available window) = $2718.9bn; implied revaluation over the same window = $10918.7bn (total level change $13637.6bn = 19.9% flow + 80.1% revaluation). NOTE this 9-quarter window is SHORTER than the brief's headline 2024:Q1-2026:Q2 (10q, $3,069.4bn) window because DFA has not yet published 2026:Q2.
